per_article_independent_sources_note: Counts are independent newsrooms. anthropic also uses Anthropic's own pricing release; chip-rule and fincen rest mainly on primary documents (Federal Register, BIS, Treasury, Singapore MDDI); fincen's one outside account is ACAMS trade press via search excerpt. amendment3 also cites X's story summary as public reaction. paid-access also cites TokenPost. The Hill (paid-access) and ACAMS (fincen) were read via search excerpts because direct fetches returned 403.

negative_check.method: After drafting: searched UAP/AARO disclosure, Pasco County and New Port Richey news, and JPMorgan; compared the candidate list against every front swept and X US trends (GTA 6, Shenzhen, Vladimir Putin, Myanmar/Rohingya, $ANT trends match leads or Also noted; others are entertainment).
negative_check.result: No new government UAP release since the Oct 23 PURSUE tranche. Pasco: sheriff copycat-site warning and Pasco 2050 session (not news that changes anything); Pasco's tax collector appears in fl-orion. JPMorgan: CFO succession and AI-agent payments test, already noted Nov 18.
negative_check.underreported: Two significant underreported items run below the line: FinCEN's immigration-status customer due diligence proposal (found only in Treasury's release, the Federal Register and banking trade press, no general-news coverage) and the remote-access chip rule's effective date (wide coverage at announcement Monday, almost none today).

feedback_applied: gh issue list --state all on News-Agent-v2 (Nov 19, ~07:30 ET): only issue #1 (brief-feedback 2026-11-08c-v2, Krakow), no comments, last updated Nov 8; already applied in config.md on Nov 9 with the wake condition closed. Topic-check answers (Nov 9-15) already in config.md were applied as weighting: AI debt and credit risk raised weight on Anthropic's $900B compute commitments and $6.2B debt; prediction markets, Tampa Bay dengue, banks blocking AI agents and Epstein Act II had no material new development today.
